Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

llm.summary: This is a local tracking/reminder skill whose persistent notes are disclosed and aligned with its stated purpose.

dimensions.detail: It reads configured memory/tracking paths and scans stored records, which is proportionate for a cross-session reminder skill but should be configured intentionally.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact is a single Markdown skill file with no bundled executable code, dependencies, install scripts, or hidden runtime components.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The natural-language triggers are broad enough to activate during ordinary conversation, but the resulting actions remain within the tracking/reminder workflow.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill writes long-lived tracking and memory files, and it explicitly warns not to store sensitive details because these files remain on disk.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill’s purpose is to store and resurface commitments, expiry dates, watch items, in-flight work, and queues; its read/write behavior directly supports that purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before installing, confirm the configured tracking and memory folders are acceptable for long-term local storage, avoid storing customer names, amounts, or other sensitive details, and use explicit invocations if you do not want ordinary phrases to trigger the skill.
llm.findings:
[SQP-1] expected: The broad conversational triggers are a usability and accidental-activation concern, but they are disclosed in the skill metadata and map to the stated tracking modes.
[SQP-2] expected: Persistent writes are central to the skill’s purpose, and the artifact discloses long-term local storage and advises against recording sensitive details.
